title: Smoke-test every exposed Station Master action through the real entrypoint

values: interlocking declaration with entrypoint.exposed: true and entrypoint.actions
facts.note: Requires parsing each interlocking's `entrypoint` block to read `exposed` and `actions`; path/file kind alone does not tell exposed from internal. This standing fact alone activates the rule for every exposed action, changed or not.
Location of the consumer's smoke tests that the detector scans for coverage.

values: bun_interlocking_coverage: exposed action without Station Master smoke test
facts.note: Emitted by the JS detector of the bun_interlocking_coverage family. Illustrative signal of a violation, not a prerequisite for applicability.
Bun stack; other stacks are owned by their own packages.

fires: Any interlocking declares `entrypoint.exposed: true` with an action, and no `e2e/**/*.ts` file references that action name, a Station Master reference, InterlockingRunner and TrainRunner — whether or not the action was touched in the current change.
A new action is added to an exposed interlocking's `entrypoint.actions` without a matching smoke test.
An existing smoke test for an exposed action stops referencing one of the production runners (e.g. calls a train directly).
doesNotFire: An interlocking with `entrypoint.exposed: false` (internal-transition-only, library-only, planned-not-exposed).
An exposed action already covered by an `e2e/**/*.ts` file referencing the action, the Station Master and both runners.
Non-Bun stack renderings of the same interlocking obligation.

given: An interlocking declares `entrypoint.exposed: true`, which requires at least one Station Master action (the user-facing route surface)
when: Any such exposed action exists (e.g. added, edited, or flagged by the coverage detector)
then: Each exposed action MUST have an `e2e/**/*.ts` smoke test driving it through the real entrypoint -> Station Master -> InterlockingRunner -> TrainRunner path.
prefer: Call the real action endpoint; assert the Station Master chose the interlocking (InterlockingRunner) path, not a direct train.
Assert InterlockingRunner resolved a route, TrainRunner ran the selected train, and the trace records interlockingId/routeId/selectedTrainId.
If the interlocking is genuinely internal, set `entrypoint.exposed: false` with a reason; it leaves scope.
avoid: Bypassing the real entrypoint/Station Master or invoking a train directly.
Merely naming the action, Station Master and runners without asserting route, train execution and trace ids.
Flipping a user-facing action to `exposed: false` to escape coverage.
unless: `entrypoint.exposed: false` (internal-transition-only / library-only / planned-not-exposed): no Station Master action, out of scope.
why: Exposed actions are critical user-facing routes; only an end-to-end smoke test proves the interlocking path and production runners execute. Criticality comes mechanically from `entrypoint.exposed`.
evidence: For each `exposed: true` action, an `e2e/**/*.ts` file exists that references the action name, `StationMaster`/`stationMaster`, `InterlockingRunner` and `TrainRunner`.
The smoke test hits the real endpoint and asserts interlocking-path choice, route resolution, selected-train execution and trace fields interlockingId/routeId/selectedTrainId.
The bun_interlocking_coverage detector reports no uncovered exposed action.
verifier_detail: JS detector (member of the `bun_interlocking_coverage` FAMILY) parses each interlocking's `entrypoint`; scans interlocking entrypoints and the consumer's `e2e/**/*.ts` tests.

Enforced minimum signature per exposed action: one `e2e/**/*.ts` file referencing the action name AND a Station Master reference (`StationMaster` or `stationMaster`) AND both production runners (`InterlockingRunner`, `TrainRunner`).

`entrypoint.exposed: true` requires at least one action (afokapu/atdd#1248); those action names are the Station Master actions checked. `exposed: false` interlockings carry no action and are never flagged.
An exposed action with a file matching the full signature is satisfied and not flagged.

Severity policy: this rule is strict (severity 1, disposition strict per policy.strict-disposition) for exposed (user-facing) actions; `exposed: false` -> out of scope. Derived from the core `entrypoint.exposed` field, mechanical, not a judgement call.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Source name: Exposed interlocking Station Master actions have smoke coverage through real entrypoints (Bun).
Bun-stack realization of the agnostic core obligation `tester.interlocking.smoke-coverage-for-station-master`; rendered for the Bun application.
Per-stack renderings other than Bun are owned by their own workspace packages.
Core design refs: afokapu/atdd#1246, afokapu/atdd#1248 (entrypoint.exposed/actions), afokapu/atdd#1251 (entrypoint -> Station Master -> InterlockingRunner -> TrainRunner path).

Terms: exposed_action = a Station Master action name listed under an interlocking's `entrypoint.actions` when `entrypoint.exposed: true` (afokapu/atdd#1248); the user-facing route surface requiring smoke coverage; exposed: false interlockings have none. station_master_smoke_test = an `e2e/**/*.ts` smoke test driving an exposed action through the real entrypoint to the Station Master, proving the interlocking path was chosen, InterlockingRunner resolved a route, TrainRunner executed the selected train, and the trace recorded interlockingId/routeId/selectedTrainId.

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: the rule fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Merely naming the action, Station Master and runners without real assertions; flipping a user-facing action to exposed: false to escape coverage.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-patterns implied by the gap between the detector's minimum signature and the normative end-to-end proof, and by the fix_hint allowing exposed: false only for genuinely internal interlockings.

additions.text: Smoke test stops referencing a production runner (direct train call).
additions.justification: Concrete firing case derived from 'chooses the interlocking path (not a direct train)'.

additions.text: Examples of triggers (added, edited, detector-flagged) are illustrative; applicability is unconditional for every exposed action.
additions.justification: Given/When structure requires an event; the source imposes a standing obligation, so the event is phrased as existence.

trace.note: Rephrased as title; original kept in audit.
